newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buyers hold back.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buyers hold back.

text.p: Tuesday's sharp advance in New York futures induced many mill buyers to stay formally on the sidelines of the raw cotton market.
The general mood appears to be that current asking rates are too expensive and that there is a lack of incentive to add further to existing purchasing commitments for the time being.

Nevertheless, sellers who are able to offer Central Asian styles for summer shipment have encountered additional buying interest and some fresh interest has been noted for Syrian styles which appears competitive against other growths.
